limits: Actual-tornado rows count whole tracks once; tracks starting outside Kansas are excluded even if they enter the state. Whole tracks can extend outside Kansas.
Straight lines join reported endpoints and are not damage footprints. Missing endpoints are not invented.
F and EF ratings are categorical damage scales. Unknown ratings remain unknown. Earlier tornadoes are underreported; observation methods and population exposure change.
Source injuries and fatalities are reported values. The snapshot ends in 2025 and is not a live alert or forecast.

sources.citation: NOAA/NWS Storm Prediction Center, 1950–2025 actual tornado tracks, rows with starting state KS; retrieved as a source snapshot.
